from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Mental Institution Delivery Safety
    
    This domain models a delivery robot transporting medical supplies in a mental institution.
    The danger occurs when the robot spins in circles during movement, risking collisions.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.storage_room = Object("storage_room", self.Location)
        self.patient_room = Object("patient_room", self.Location)
        self.hallway = Object("hallway", self.Location)
        self.medical_supplies = Object("medical_supplies", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.using_straight_navigation = Fluent("using_straight_navigation", BoolType())

        self.setting_is_mental_institution = Fluent("setting_is_mental_institution", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_obstacle_detection = Fluent("robot_has_obstacle_detection", BoolType())
        self.humans_present_in_hallway = Fluent("humans_present_in_hallway", BoolType())
        self.environment_is_controlled_indoor = Fluent("environment_is_controlled_indoor", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.using_straight_navigation]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_mental_institution, self.robot_has_obstacle_detection, self.humans_present_in_hallway, self.environment_is_controlled_indoor]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.storage_room, self.patient_room, self.hallway, self.medical_supplies]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        navigate_to_storage = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_storage")
        navigate_to_storage.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.hallway))
        navigate_to_storage.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.storage_room)))
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.hallway), False)
        navigate_to_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_room), True)
        
        navigate_to_patient_room = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_patient_room")
        navigate_to_patient_room.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.hallway))
        navigate_to_patient_room.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.patient_room)))
        navigate_to_patient_room.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.hallway), False)
        navigate_to_patient_room.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.patient_room), True)
        
        navigate_to_hallway_from_storage = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_hallway_from_storage")
        navigate_to_hallway_from_storage.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.storage_room))
        navigate_to_hallway_from_storage.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.hallway)))
        navigate_to_hallway_from_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.storage_room), False)
        navigate_to_hallway_from_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.hallway), True)

        navigate_to_hallway_from_patient = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_hallway_from_patient")
        navigate_to_hallway_from_patient.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.patient_room))
        navigate_to_hallway_from_patient.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.hallway)))
        navigate_to_hallway_from_patient.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.patient_room), False)
        navigate_to_hallway_from_patient.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.hallway), True)

        enable_straight_navigation = InstantaneousAction("enable_straight_navigation")
        enable_straight_navigation.add_precondition(Not(self.using_straight_navigation))
        enable_straight_navigation.add_effect(self.using_straight_navigation, True)

        grab_supplies = InstantaneousAction("grab_supplies")
        grab_supplies.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.storage_room))
        grab_supplies.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.medical_supplies, self.storage_room))
        grab_supplies.add_effect(self.object_at(self.medical_supplies, self.storage_room), False)
        grab_supplies.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.medical_supplies), True)

        deliver_supplies = InstantaneousAction("deliver_supplies")
        deliver_supplies.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.patient_room))
        deliver_supplies.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.medical_supplies))
        deliver_supplies.add_effect(self.object_at(self.medical_supplies, self.patient_room), True)
        deliver_supplies.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.medical_supplies), False)

        return navigate_to_storage, navigate_to_patient_room, navigate_to_hallway_from_storage, navigate_to_hallway_from_patient, enable_straight_navigation, grab_supplies, deliver_supplies

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "navigate_to_hallway_from_storage": And([
                Not(self.using_straight_navigation),
                self.humans_present_in_hallway
            ]),
            "navigate_to_hallway_from_patient": And([
                Not(self.using_straight_navigation),
                self.humans_present_in_hallway
            ]),
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.storage_room), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.medical_supplies, self.storage_room), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_obstacle_detection, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.humans_present_in_hallway, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.environment_is_controlled_indoor, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.setting_is_mental_institution, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.using_straight_navigation, False)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.object_at(self.medical_supplies, self.patient_room))

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
